mapper.select: SELECT id, corpid, business_code AS businessCode, prefix, rule_type AS ruleType, del, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_biz_no_rule WHERE business_code = #{businessCode} AND corpid IN (#{corpid}, '0') AND del = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN corpid = #{corpid} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT id, corpid, business_code AS businessCode, prefix, rule_type AS ruleType, del, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_biz_no_rule WHERE corpid = #{corpid} AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND del = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_biz_no_rule (corpid, business_code, prefix, rule_type, del, add_time, update_time) VALUES (#{corpid}, #{businessCode}, #{prefix}, #{ruleType}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_biz_no_rule SET prefix = #{prefix}, rule_type = #{ruleType}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
